groups.defect: The prefix and suffix trimming loops can overlap, so substring() gets an end index below its start and throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of reporting illegal HTML.
groups.rationale: Both report the same uncapped suffix scan at lines 101-111 causing a substring crash, and both propose the same fix.

groups.defect: error-invalid-multivalued-size in the React admin-ui and account-ui English bundles was switched to MessageFormat {0}/choice syntax, which i18next does not interpolate, so users see raw placeholders.
groups.rationale: All report the same i18next/MessageFormat mismatch for the same key. Some point at the admin-ui file and one at the account-ui file, so the merged comment has to cover both files.

groups.defect: The Lithuanian totpStep1 (account) and loginTotpStep1 (login) messages were replaced with Italian text.
groups.rationale: The same wrong Italian string was copied into two Lithuanian bundles, and each needs its own Lithuanian translation.

groups.defect: The zh_CN totpStep1 message uses Traditional Chinese characters instead of Simplified.
groups.rationale: Same line and the same defect, a Traditional Chinese string in the Simplified Chinese bundle.
